task: After a successful startup auto-update, re-execute the original codemie command in a fresh process (preserving argv, cwd, env, stdio, exit status/signal, no update loop) with bin-level regression tests.

key_reasoning.reason: No re-launch mechanism exists in the repo. The closest precedents are exec() in src/utils/exec.ts (piped stdio, rejects on signal death) and run-skills-cli.ts spawn(process.execPath) (runs a different script). Neither gives transparent pass-through of exit code, signal, TTY or stdin. Windows .cmd shims and replacing a running install add risk. The loop guard currently relies only on the .last-update-check timestamp, which CODEMIE_UPDATE_CHECK_INTERVAL=0 defeats, so a re-entry marker is needed. The AC also enumerates variant cases (version, doctor, list, analytics, non-interactive) and no existing fake-npm test template covers them, which adds to the risk. There is no auth or secret surface, and rollback is easy.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk set to L: no exact precedent for transparent process relaunch, and the AC enumerates edge variants with no covering test template
